decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority(before the building is occupied.

Condition : 3 - Full details including samples of the following:
a. Railings, finials and gate b. brickwork
shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the LPA before the building is occupied.

Condition : 4 - Full details of all ground surface treatment on the site including hard and soft landscaping shall be submtted to and approved in writing before any work on the site is commenced. The details shall include hard surfacing materials, planting plans, schedules of plants noting species, plant sizes and proposed densities/numbers.  The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of refuse or waste have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing of refuse or waste shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 6 - The building shall not be occupied until details of the appearance and a sound attenuation schem for the proposed air conditioning units has been submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA

Condition : 7 - Before the building is occupied a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the building shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 8 - The gate to the car parking area shall be kept permanently open between the hours of 7am to 7pm in order to allow unimpeded access for all vehicular traffic to the site during these times.
description: Glazing and cladding changes to facades, erection of ground floor front extension,  replacement of air conditioning system, relocation of building entrance,  and part new boundary treatment to offices.
